task.name: Size-efficient sorting networks on 16 wires
task.description: Construct a fixed compare-exchange network that sorts all 16-input sequences using as few comparators as possible. Correctness is certified by the zero-one principle over all 65,536 Boolean inputs. Parallel depth is reported separately. A verified 60-comparator construction is the reference; the initial odd-even transposition network uses 120 comparators.
task.contract: construct() -> ordered list of integer pairs (i, j), 0 <= i < j < N. Each compare-exchange writes min to wire i and max to j. The network must sort every input. Score: comparator count, minimized; parallel depth is reported separately. Maximum 4096 comparators.
